payload.title: A1 · Ik heb last van…
payload.patternExplanation: Use ik heb last van… to describe a symptom when arranging care, without needing to explain its cause.

lines.dutch: Goedemiddag, ik wil graag een afspraak maken bij de huisarts.
lines.english: Good afternoon, I would like to make an appointment with the GP.
lines.telugu: శుభ మధ్యాహ్నం, నేను కుటుంబ వైద్యుడితో అపాయింట్‌మెంట్ తీసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నాను.

lines.dutch: Wat is er aan de hand?
Ik heb last van mijn keel en ik voel mij niet goed.
lines.english: I have trouble with my throat and I do not feel well.
lines.telugu: నాకు గొంతు నొప్పిగా ఉంది మరియు నాకు బాగా అనిపించడం లేదు.

lines.dutch: Ik heb last van hoofdpijn sinds gisteren.
lines.english: I have had a headache since yesterday.

lines.dutch: De huisarts kan u morgen bellen.
lines.english: The GP can call you tomorrow.
lines.telugu: కుటుంబ వైద్యుడు రేపు మీకు ఫోన్ చేయవచ్చు.

practiceExercises.prompt: Choose the phrase that fits the situation.
practiceExercises.context: Tell the GP receptionist about your throat: ___ mijn keel.
practiceExercises.feedback: Use ik heb last van here: ik heb last van.
